nota: Hand-curated points (data centres outside or beyond the Epoch AI tracker, data-centre hubs, chip fabs, advanced packaging, equipment and material chokepoints). Coordinates: estimated with OSM Nominatim geocoding of the town or area named by the source, unless stated otherwise in origine_coord; precisione_km row by row. mw = power in MW as given by the source (IT or grid: see mw_tipo). importo = declared investment in BILLIONS of the stated currency (e.g. 2400 KRW = 2,400 bn won = 2.4 trillion), not money spent. nome_en = English name for rows whose 'nome' is kept verbatim because raccolta/supply-chain-ai/nodi.json references it. Last hand update: 2026-11-10.
